63.8: He said, "These My people for real. They ain't gon' lie to Me." So He became their Savior.
63.9: When they suffered, He felt it. His Angel showed up and saved 'em. He loved 'em deep, had pity on 'em, Carried 'em through the years like a Father carries His baby.
63.10: But they wilded out. Grieved His Spirit. So He had to flip it—became their enemy, And fought back against 'em.
63.11: Then they started rememberin' the old days, When Moses was leadin' and God was movin'. They asked, "Where's the One who brought us through the sea? Where's the One who dropped His Spirit on us?"
63.12: He was the One who led Moses by the hand, Showed out with glory, split the sea in two—All to put some respect on His name.
63.13: He took 'em through the deep Like a horse ridin' smooth in the wilderness—Didn't let 'em trip.
63.14: Like cattle restin' in a quiet valley, His Spirit gave 'em peace. That's how You led Your people, God—To show off Your greatness.
63.15: God, look down from heaven, From Your holy, glorious crib—Where Your passion at? Your power? Don't hold back Your love on me now.
63.16: You our real Father. Abraham might not know us, Israel might forget us, But You, Lord? You been our Redeemer forever.
63.17: Lord, why You let us wander so far? Why our hearts so cold, like we forgot how to fear You? Please come back—for Your people's sake. We Your chosen ones.
63.18: We had Your holy place for a moment, Then our enemies came through and stomped it out.
63.19: Now we feel like strangers—Like folks You ain't never ruled, Like folks who ain't even called by Your name.

64.1: Lord, if only You would just tear the sky open and come down! Let the mountains shake when You show up.
64.2: Like fire hittin' dry branches, Like a pot boilin' over—Show these folks who You are, So every nation trembles when You roll in.
64.3: When You did stuff nobody saw comin', You stepped down, And the mountains had to bow down just from Your presence.
64.4: Ain't nobody ever heard, Ain't no ear ever caught it, Ain't no eye ever seen a God like You—One who moves on behalf of the one who waits on You.
64.5: You come through for the ones who got joy in doin' right, Who keep Your ways in mind. But You got angry 'cause we kept messin' up—We been stuck in these sins… Lord, we need You to save us.
64.6: Truth be told, we all messed up. Even our "best behavior" look like dirty rags. We fade like dead leaves in the wind, Our sins blow us wherever like we got no roots.
64.7: Ain't nobody even callin' on Your name like they should. Ain't nobody reachin' out to hold onto You. You turned Your face from us, Let our sins eat us up.
64.8: But still—You our Father, Lord. We just the clay, You the potter. We all the work of Your hands.
64.9: Don't stay mad at us forever, Lord. Please don't hold these sins over us. Just look at us—we still Your people!
64.10: Your holy cities? Straight up wastelands now. Zion look like a ghost town. Jerusalem in ruins.
64.11: The temple we loved—Where our ancestors gave You praise? Burned up. All the beautiful stuff? Gone.
64.12: Lord… are You really gon' stay silent over this? You not gon' say nothin'? You just gon' let us keep sufferin' like this?

65.1: "I let Myself be found by folks who wasn't even lookin'. People who didn't even ask about Me—found Me anyway. I said, 'Here I am! Here I am!' To a nation that wasn't even claimin' My name."
65.2: "I kept My hands outstretched all day To a stubborn, rebellious people Who stay doin' whatever they want, Goin' off their own thoughts instead of My way.
65.3: They keep testin' Me to My face—Burnin' incense in wild gardens, Buildin' altars on bricks instead of where I told 'em.
65.4: They sittin' out by graves, spendin' nights in tombs, Eatin' pig meat and messin' with all kinds of unclean stuff.
65.5: Then they got the nerve to say, 'Back up, don't touch me! I'm too holy for you!' Man, that's like smoke in My nose—That kinda mess stay irritatin' Me."
65.6: "I got all this written down. I ain't just gon' sit quiet—nah, I'ma pay y'all back.
65.7: Your sins and your ancestors' sins both, Burnin' incense on them hills, Disrespectin' Me constantly—So now I'ma pay it all back to y'all straight up."
65.8: "But just like you don't throw out a whole grape cluster 'Cause there's still juice in it—I ain't gon' wipe everybody out. I got some faithful ones, And for their sake, I'ma hold back the wrath.
65.9: Outta Jacob and Judah, I'ma bring out a people Who'll actually inherit what I promised. They My chosen ones, and they gon' live in it.
65.10: The plains of Sharon? Gonna be full of sheep. The Valley of Achor? Peaceful place for cattle. All for My folks who truly sought Me."
65.11: "But y'all who ditched Me? Who forgot all about My mountain, Who out here pourin' drinks for fake gods—Yeah, I see you.
65.12: That's why y'all gon' be numbered for the sword. You gon' be laid out, 'Cause when I called, you ignored Me. When I spoke, y'all didn't listen. Instead, you did the opposite of what I asked."
65.13: So this is what God says: "My servants gon' eat good—But y'all gon' be hungry. They'll drink—Y'all stay thirsty. They'll be out here celebratin'—Y'all gon' be ashamed.
65.14: My servants gon' be singin' with joy, But y'all? Y'all gon' be weepin', heartbroken, Cryin' in pain.
65.15: Your name gon' be used like a curse by My chosen ones. But I'm gon' call My real ones by a whole new name."
65.16: "From now on, if somebody bless theyself, They gon' bless theyself in the name of the true God. Ain't nobody thinkin' about them old hard times no more. That stuff been wiped clean from My view."
65.17: "Look, I'm creatin' a new heaven and new earth. The past? Gone. Forgotten.
65.18: Be glad, for real. Jerusalem gon' be full of joy. Her people? Straight happiness.
65.19: I'm gon' be smilin' over Jerusalem, Lovin' on My folks. Ain't gon' be no more cryin' or heartbreak there.
65.20: Babies won't die young no more. Old folks gon' live long, full lives. If somebody dies at a hundred, folks'll think, 'Dang, they must've done somethin' wrong!'
65.21: Folks gon' build houses—and actually live in 'em. Plant vineyards—and eat their own fruit.
65.22: No more buildin' for somebody else to move in. No more workin' just for somebody else to take the harvest. Nah, My people gon' live long like trees, And enjoy the fruit of their grind.
65.23: They ain't gon' waste their energy. Their kids ain't gon' grow up for pain and destruction. They're the blessed ones, And their kids? Blessed too.
65.24: Before they even call Me—I'm already respondin'. While they still talkin', I'm already movin'.
65.25: The wolf and the lamb gon' eat together in peace. The lion gon' munch on straw like an ox. And snakes? They'll stay eatin' dirt. Ain't nobody gon' hurt or destroy nothin' In all My holy mountain," says the Lord.

66.1: God said, "Heaven is My throne, and earth? That's just My footrest. So what house could y'all build for Me? What place could actually hold My presence?"
66.2: "I made all this—everything you see. But the one I look at with love? That humble one. That broken-spirited one who trembles at My Word."
66.3: "Some of y'all actin' holy, but y'all outta pocket. Killin' a bull like it's murder. Offerin' lambs like breakin' a dog's neck. Burnin' incense like it's some idol party. You chose your own path, delighted in mess—So I'ma let that mess turn right back on you.
66.4: When I called, you ignored Me. When I spoke, y'all ain't listen. So now? I'ma give y'all exactly what you feared. 'Cause you chose what I hate."
66.5: "Listen up, y'all who really honor My word—Even when your own people kick you out for My name. They said, 'Let the Lord be glorified...' But really, they just hatin'. Don't worry—shame comin' their way."
66.6: You hear that noise from the city? That voice in the temple? Yeah, that's Me. God speakin'—and I ain't holdin' back.
66.7: "Before she even felt the pain, she gave birth. A son, just like that.
66.8: Who's ever heard somethin' like that? A whole nation born in one day? But that's how Zion rolled—Soon as labor hit, boom!—her kids came through."
66.9: "You really think I'ma bring you to the edge of breakthrough And not deliver? Nah. If I open the womb, I'ma bring life too."
66.10: "Y'all better rejoice with Jerusalem. Celebrate her—especially y'all that cried over her.
66.11: 'Cause now? She about to pour out comfort like milk. Y'all gon' be full, satisfied, delighted."
66.12: "I'm sendin' peace like a river, And blessings flowin' like a stream. Gentiles gon' bring gifts, And you gon' be held, carried, and comforted.
66.13: Just like a mama rockin' her baby—That's how I'ma comfort y'all in Jerusalem."
66.14: When y'all see it, your heart gon' light up. Bones gon' be strong again. Servants get grace. Enemies? Gonna feel that heat.
66.15: Look, the Lord comin' with fire. Chariots spinnin' like tornados. Wrath ain't just poetic—it's real.
66.16: By sword and flame, God judge everybody. And it's gon' be a whole lotta bodies.
66.17: "Those folks tryna 'cleanse' themselves to chase idols? Eatin' pork and all kinds of mess? They all gettin' wiped out together."
66.18: "I see what folks do and what they think. And soon, I'm gatherin' every nation and tongue. They gon' see My glory.
66.19: I'ma mark the survivors, Send 'em out to far nations—Tarshish, Pul, Lud, Tubal, Javan. Places that ain't heard of Me—yet. And My name gon' hit every corner of the earth."
66.20: "They gon' bring your brothers and sisters back to Me—From every nation, like a holy parade. On horses, chariots, wagons, mules—whatever it takes. Just like Israel used to do with clean offerings.
66.21: And guess what? Some of these outsiders? Yeah, I'ma make 'em priests and Levites too."
66.22: "The new heaven and new earth I'm buildin'? That's permanent. Just like your descendants and your name—They ain't goin' nowhere."
66.23: "From one New Moon to the next, From Sabbath to Sabbath, All flesh—everybody—gon' come worship Me."
66.24: "And they gon' see the bodies—The ones who went against Me. Their worm never dies. Their fire never goes out. It's gon' be a horror show for all to witness."
